spendControl.activationRule: Record a founder-approved OpenAI project monthly spend limit with hard-limit enforcement enabled, an earlier spend alert, and credential-free platform evidence before activating this policy or adding the repository secret.

recommendation.rationale: Start with a deliberately small, reversible project cap and a halfway warning while real per-mission usage is measured. This is an operating guardrail, not a revenue forecast or approval.

workflows.purpose: Draft one founder-approved research bundle and run a separate independent editorial review.
Propose one evidence-backed gift opportunity and run a separate opportunity red team.
Independently review one exact editorial run after its founder safety gate.
Propose one measured growth experiment from committed aggregate evidence only.
Turn one owner-authored executive brief into a proposed strategy record without approving it.
Independently review one exact paid-link candidate without approving or activating it.

directApiWorkflows.purpose: Generate one hash-bound visual batch and run a separate multimodal review before any credential-free Git promotion.

shutdownConditions: A missing repository secret stops the job before a model call.
A policy that is not active stops the job even if a credential appears.
Missing project hard-limit, early-alert, or platform evidence prevents policy activation.
Workflow permission, sandbox, session, or credential-placement drift fails deterministic validation.
Any proposed patch outside its workflow-specific allowlist fails deterministic validation.
A project hard-limit response, repeated failures, or suspected credential exposure requires the founder to disable runs and rotate the credential before resuming.
